results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can ensure all articles are visually appealing and consistent with the site’s style guidelines.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must be able to adjust text fonts, sizes, and colors with a WYSIWYG editor.
- The system should allow for the insertion and customization of images and videos within 5 minutes.
- Articles should display consistently across devices, maintaining the intended layout and style.

Test Outline:
- Use the WYSIWYG editor to modify text attributes and verify visual changes align with editor inputs.
- Insert and customize multimedia elements, ensuring completion within the time limit.
- Test article appearance on multiple devices to confirm layout consistency.

It defines concrete acceptance criteria for text formatting, multimedia handling, and cross-device consistency, which are quantifiable and testable, enhancing the INVEST qualities of the user story.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that each article is visually appealing and adheres to brand guidelines.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editor must be able to adjust text styles, including font size, color, and alignment, with a 100% accuracy in rendering.
- Image and video placement tools should allow for precise positioning and resizing within the article.
- The system should offer a preview feature to view changes in real-time before publishing, ensuring adherence to visual standards.

Test Outline:
- Verify the ability to modify text styles and check that changes render correctly across different browsers.
- Test image and video placement tools for ease of use and accuracy in positioning and resizing.
- Use the preview feature to review articles before publishing and confirm that visual standards are met.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout options so that I can ensure all articles are visually appealing and adhere to brand guidelines.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must have access to a toolbar with at least 10 formatting options (e.g., font size, color, alignment).
- Changes made to the article layout should be rendered in real-time with no more than a 1-second delay.
- The system should include a preview function to view the final layout before publishing.

Test Outline:
- Verify the availability and functionality of at least 10 formatting options in the editor toolbar.
- Make layout changes and measure the time taken for real-time rendering to ensure it is ≤1 second.
- Use the preview function to confirm that it accurately represents the final published layout.
